title: Three kinds of nothing

data.source: Three small constructions, seeded: a drifting noisy path read at four step sizes; the one-weight learner of Phoenix study TWO-CLOCKS-MC-2026-10-06 (as rebuilt in the library's as-true-pause room); and the contemplative lens's accumulate-to-threshold sitter. No human data.

phoenix_status: CORE/MATHEMATICS.md, section VII, status ONTOLOGY: "the present is an empty boundary carrying conditions inherited from that history". R2 is an ASSUMPTION: "For an adapted continuous path this is a stopping time." AI_SAFETY/EMPTY_CENTRE.md: "The Empty Centre is not a claim that a model literally has no internal state." NOT DECIDABLE register, ND-4: "the ontological \"emptiness\" has no measurement"; breaking intervention: "none for the ontology".
prediction: The three constructions reproduce (a cut bracketed by exactly one reading step at every step size, the brackets nesting as the step shrinks; a pause that leaves no trace in a frozen world and a trace of 9.999998631 in a moving one; a key press that records one cut in two), and none of them bears on whether the present is an empty boundary.
baseline: The ordinary names for the same three things: an event time in any threshold model; checkpoint and restore with deterministic replay; a record with missing events. And a decoy cut that does have a width.
why: One of the check's own three statements was wrong, so by the rule fixed beforehand this room fails. The pause and the unwitnessed cut came out as built. But the cut with no width did not behave as written: read more finely, the path does not show the same crossing more sharply, it shows an earlier one. Even the plainest nothing of the three depends on a resolution chosen in advance. The ontology was not tested. Nothing here could test it, and Phoenix itself records that it has no measurement.

alternatives.forks: K1 held at 5 of 9 other levels and noise sizes; K3's gap between spell CV and recorded CV appears at spell CV 0.3 and 0.5 too.

operating_characteristics: K1 to K3 hold by construction whether or not the present is an empty boundary. No outcome would weigh 3 to 1 either way.
would_make_it_testable: The lens's protocol: random probes, a key press at each noticing, a passive breathing belt, and afterwards a trained interview about one noticing and one breath turn, coded blind for duration, content and whether the onset was lived or only inferred. "Nothing in the cut" as description predicts no duration and no content.
